WITH show_views AS (
    SELECT 
        s.title,
        COUNT(*) AS total_views,
        SUM(CASE WHEN u.plan = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS premium_views
    FROM 
        views v
    JOIN 
        episodes e ON v.episode_id = e.id
    JOIN 
        shows s ON e.show_id = s.id
    JOIN 
        users u ON v.user_id = u.id
    GROUP BY 
        s.title
)
SELECT 
    title,
    CAST(premium_views AS REAL) / total_views AS share
FROM 
    show_views;
```

WITH account_info AS (
    SELECT 
        c.name,
        a.opened,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY a.opened) AS rn_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY a.opened DESC) AS rn_desc
    FROM 
        customers c
    JOIN 
        accounts a ON c.id = a.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    name,
    julianday(max(opened)) - julianday(min(opened)) AS days_passed
FROM 
    account_info
WHERE 
    rn_asc = 1 OR rn_desc = 1
GROUP BY 
    name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1;
```
